scripture.verse: "He has made us accepted in the Beloved."

"Do all things without murmurings and disputing, that you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom you shine as lights in the world; holding forth the Word of Life, that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither labored in vain."
"But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was."
"Jesus said unto him, If you can believe, all things are possible to him that believes.'"
"Many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in and shall not be able."
"For our conversation is in Heaven; from where also we look for the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ."

sermons.title: Sermon 477 | Never! Never! Never! Never! Never!

scripture.verse: "He hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee."
"For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings." Hebrews 2:10.
